item.title: Fixing TensorFlow CPU Optimization Warnings: Enabling AVX, SSE Instructions with Bazel
item.description:
“Fixing TensorFlow CPU Optimization Warnings: Enabling AVX, SSE Instructions with Bazel”

How can one recompile TensorFlow from source using bazel to include these specific instruction sets, thereby mitigating the warnings and potentially gaining significant speed improvements for computation-intensive tasks?

Addressing TensorFlow CPU Optimization Warnings via Source Compilation

The warnings arise because pre-built TensorFlow wheels typically target a wide range of x86-64 systems, often defaulting to older instruction sets like SSE4.1 for maximum compatibility. To leverage newer, faster instructions like AVX or SSE4.2, recompilation targeting the specific host CPU is required.
